$comment: World hazards (ruleset v0). lethalDropMm: a cell with a 4-neighbour at least this much lower is a cliff top, lethal to be pushed or launched off (tech notes, sections 3 and 5). No spec has set it: spec pass S2 does, so the file is marked placeholder; 4 m is a two-storey fall, about where a toy-like tumble stops being survivable.
